body.query: What products of the pulp and paper industry are sort listed to be included in an extension of the CBAM

response.answer:
The following products of the pulp and paper industry are shortlisted to be included in an extension of the CBAM:

*   **Pulp (HS Chapter 47):**
    *   Mechanical wood pulp, not chemically treated (HS 4701) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215; page 159, chunk 315)
    *   Chemical wood pulp, dissolving grades (HS 4702) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215; page 159, chunk 315)
    *   Chemical wood pulp, soda or sulphate (excl. dissolving grades) (HS 4703) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215; page 159, chunk 315)
    *   Chemical wood pulp, sulphite (excl. dissolving grades) (HS 4704) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215; page 159, chunk 315)
    *   Wood pulp obtained by a combination of mechanical and chemical pulping processes (HS 4705) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215; page 159, chunk 315)
*   **Paper and paperboard (HS Chapter 48):**
    *   Newsprint (HS 4801) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215)
    *   Uncoated paper and paperboard, of a kind used for writing, printing or other graphic purposes (HS 4802), with the exception of handmade papers (HS 480210) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215)
    *   Toilet or facial tissue stock, towel or (HS 4803) (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215)
    *   All CN codes under HS Chapter 48 (paper and paperboard) are considered for extension, should the main precursor HS Chapter 47 (wood pulp) be included in the CBAM. (Source: CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 56, chunk 117)

**Evidence:**
*   CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 56, chunk 117
*   CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 101, chunk 215
*   CBAM horizontal extension Final Report _CLEAN_31.10.2025.pdf, page 159, chunk 315
